creative_direction_json.core_angle: A hook should be understandable before the viewer commits attention.
creative_direction_json.point_of_view: A practical editor teaching a fast self-check.
creative_direction_json.visual_strategy: Fast creator desk cuts, phone preview motion, timeline trimming, no readable UI text.
consistency_rules: Do not promise views or growth.
Keep the screen content abstract and unreadable.

hook_option_1: If your Reel needs six seconds to make sense, the hook is late.
hook_option_2: Try this three-second test before posting your next Reel.
hook_option_3: Your hook should work before the viewer turns the sound on.
selected_hook: Try this three-second test before posting your next Reel.
narration_script: Try this three-second test before posting your next Reel. Mute the draft. Watch only the first three seconds. If you cannot tell what the video is about, tighten the opening shot, cut the setup, and start with the result. The goal is not to explain everything. The goal is to make the next second feel obvious.
short_script: Mute the draft, watch three seconds, and cut anything that delays the point.
caption_draft: Before posting: mute your Reel and watch the first three seconds. If the idea is not clear, the hook is late.
cta_line: Use this on your next edit.
music_direction: Fast dry percussion with light clicks and no heavy bass.
